description: Discipline anchors for skills/agenda-intelligence/SKILL.md. Each anchor is a phrase or pattern the skill text MUST contain because a rubric dimension depends on it. If the skill drops an anchor, the rubric will predictably regress on the linked dimensions — so the gate hard-rejects the edit before any LLM-judge or human review.

anchors.rationale: Skill must instruct the model to identify the delta vs producing a news summary.
The six evidence-separation labels are the operationalization of evidence discipline. Missing any one collapses the dimension.
Skill must explicitly forbid implying live verification when none was performed. Removal of this anchor is the single highest-risk drift mode.
Negative-discipline anchor: must explicitly call out the most common drift behaviors.

any_of: re-anchor the analysis to the actual timeline
verify it against the current date
anchors.rationale: Skill should instruct the model to check the question's temporal premise (asserted elapsed time / effective date) before analyzing, rather than silently adopting the caller's date. Surfaced during dogfooding 2026-05-28: a question said '12-month effect' when ~23 months had elapsed. Soft because a smaller skill may handle this implicitly.
Signal classification is a fixed enum. If any value disappears the model will silently invent variants.
Most common silent drift: model collapses signal-marker into signal-strength. Skill must explicitly prohibit this.

any_of: Read only the smallest needed subset
When a case crosses regional and sector
anchors.rationale: Skill should guide minimal lens loading + composition. Soft because some skills may not need this if lens set is small.
If skill drops the watch-next requirement, decision-usefulness collapses.
Skill must explicitly forbid legal/compliance/financial/etc. advice.
Communication-discipline anchor (brevity / cuts). Soft because format may vary.
The default output template encodes the rubric expectations. Dropping fields predictably regresses multiple dimensions.
